newsitem.title: USA: Calif. to refund $56 mln to taxpayers - tax board.
newsitem.headline: Calif. to refund $56 mln to taxpayers - tax board.

text.p: Refunds totaling $56 million will be issued to California taxpayers who failed to claim an overpayment of state disability insurance, the state's Franchise Tax Board said Monday.

Nearly 600,000 refunds will be sent out over the next two months to the taxpayers, who had excess disability insurance withheld and failed to claim the overpayment on their 1993, 1994 and 1995 tax returns, the tax board said.
Employers withhold state disability insurance from an employee's wages and pay it to the state Employment Development Department. The amount withheld is based on a percentage of the employee's wages.
